mapper.select: SELECT h.stock_code as stockCode, sm.stock_name as stockName, h.quantity, h.avg_price as avgPrice, nl.total_score as aiScore, nl.lstm_score as lstmScore, nl.tcn_score as tcnScore, nl.xgb_score as xgbScore, nl.reason as aiReason, cf.revenue, cf.op_profit as opProfit, cf.roe FROM holdings h JOIN stock_master sm ON h.stock_code COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = sm.stock_code COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci LEFT JOIN ( SELECT * FROM ai_next_leaders WHERE id IN (SELECT MAX(id) FROM ai_next_leaders GROUP BY stock_code) ) nl ON h.stock_code COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = nl.stock_code COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci LEFT JOIN ( SELECT cf1.* FROM company_financials cf1 JOIN ( SELECT stock_code, MAX(CONCAT(report_year, report_code)) as latest_report FROM company_financials GROUP BY stock_code ) cf2 ON cf1.stock_code = cf2.stock_code AND CONCAT(cf1.report_year, cf1.report_code) = cf2.latest_report ) cf ON h.stock_code COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = cf.stock_code COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci WHERE h.USRID = #{usrid}
SELECT insight_text FROM user_market_insight WHERE USRID = #{usrid} AND insight_type = 'BLACKBOX' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
